انهلكن (form VII)
# اِنْهَلَكْنَ (inhalakna) /in.ha.lak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# اِنْهَلِكْنَ (inhalikna) /in.ha.lik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
